name: local-review-workbench
description: Explain a change and review local code with bounded independent perspectives, compatibility checks, and validated findings.

interface.shortDescription: Understand changes and validate review findings.
interface.longDescription: A preview, skills-only workflow for session-aware, read-only code review. Explain intent, inspect correctness and backward compatibility, consider bounded simplification and naming, and independently validate findings before presenting a human review map. Uses the configured model and available tools without an automatic hook or hosted service.
defaultPrompt: Use $review-local-changes to explain the bundled compatibility fixture and review its before/after change without editing files. Do not read the evaluation answer key until the review is complete.
Use $review-local-changes on my current changes. Explain what this PR does and where I should focus my review, then report only validated issues and clearly separate optional suggestions.
